primary_object_card.object_statement: This lane is a deterministic finite associative-matrix control battery: QICS QuantRelEntr measures Umegaki relative-entropy contraction for the copied 16-stage CPTP channel contract, while a non-CP Bloch expansion must trigger both Choi negativity and a numerical DPI violation.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Defines 28 associative qubit channels, six seeded state pairs, QICS and spectral DPI checks, and the mandatory non-CP expansion kill control.
Read-only source of model constants and the sixteen down-composition Bloch targets copied into the standalone battery.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The primary object is the finite numeric control instrument itself: a standalone deterministic program that reconstructs the repository's eight terrain flows, four native operator channels, and sixteen terrain-first composed stages, certifies their Choi and trace-preserving structure, asks QICS for every relative-entropy value, cross-checks those values spectrally, and proves the instrument can fail by detecting both structural and numeric defects in one deliberately non-CP map.

native_terms.contract channel: One locally reconstructed qubit map whose constants and sixteen standard-probe outputs are locked to the read-only targets contract.
native_terms.false variant: The trace-preserving unital Bloch expansion with scale one point five that must expose Choi negativity and relative-entropy expansion.
native_terms.associative entropy control: A finite complex matrix-algebra check of Umegaki relative entropy that carries no exceptional or Jordan-algebra inference.

weirdness_signature: The sixteen composed channels must reproduce copied standard-probe targets before any entropy result counts.
QICS QuantRelEntr is load-bearing while an independently implemented eigendecomposition remains a mandatory comparator.
The false map must fail twice through a negative Choi eigenvalue and a DPI violation larger than one e minus six.
primary_object_card.domain: Finite full-rank two-by-two complex density matrices and twenty-eight explicitly reconstructed linear qubit maps.
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: Append-only JSON evidence containing anchor residuals, CPTP certificates, QICS and spectral DPI margins, false-control detections, and a bounded claim ceiling.
allowed_operations: reconstruct the copied terrain generators and native operator maps
integrate the linear GKSL flow with deterministic float64 RK4
construct Choi matrices from matrix-unit actions
evaluate fixed-input quantum relative entropy through QICS QuantRelEntr
cross-check with a local spectral Umegaki calculation
version result paths without replacing prior artifacts
required_invariants: all sixteen stage anchors remain within one e minus six of copied contract targets
all accepted channels are trace preserving and have no Choi eigenvalue below minus one e minus nine
all seeded accepted-channel QICS DPI margins are at least minus one e minus nine
all QICS values agree with the independent spectral values within one e minus eight
the false variant has both a negative Choi eigenvalue and a DPI violation above one e minus six
existing artifacts are never deleted moved or overwritten
forbidden_substitutions: QICS solver success used as a proxy for the copied channel-anchor check
spectral-only values substituted for the load-bearing QICS values
the existing Physlib GREEN receipt replaced by a new Lean run
associative matrix controls relabeled as exceptional or Jordan DPI evidence
negative_controls: non-CP Bloch expansion c equals one point five must have a negative Choi eigenvalue
the same expansion must increase QICS relative entropy by more than one e minus six
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: QICS is a numeric probe and Physlib is a separate existing theorem receipt; neither may be promoted beyond associative finite-matrix entropy controls, and the Physlib leg is not rerun.
promotion_locks: no exceptional or Jordan-algebra DPI inference is licensed
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: This lane's persistent qics_battery.py, run_all.sh, result JSON family, and unchanged physlib_dpi_axiom_check.txt receipt.

lateral_mappings.label: QICS QuantRelEntr numeric oracle
lateral_mappings.target: fixed-input Umegaki relative entropy values for finite complex matrices
preserves: the exact input and output density matrices
the direction and numeric size of each DPI margin
preconditions: the copied channels pass their contract anchors and CPTP certificates
the pinned interpreter imports QICS from the requested checkout
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If the c equals one point five non-CP map is not structurally rejected and numerically expansive, abort the whole instrument as broken.

root_constraints: finite seeded matrix inputs and finite channel family

fixation_breakers: Demote every green DPI value if the false-control two-part kill test does not pass.

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair the first contract-anchor, CPTP, QICS-comparator, false-control, or persistence failure without weakening its threshold.
loop_contract.stop_condition: Stop when two fresh runner invocations are deterministic and green, or when a named hard gate remains red and the lane is reported broken.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question is not authorization; this task is implementation-authorized only by the user's explicit build request.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Check channel content separately from composition order, with the sixteen copied terrain-first Bloch targets serving as the order witness.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve every existing artifact and visible output baseline while debugging the new runner underneath it.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: For the target associative DPI instrument, the strongest falsifier is a false-green non-CP expansion; the decisive check is joint Choi negativity and QICS violation, classified killed, open, or survived before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: The operation applies each channel to seeded states, the observable is the input-minus-output relative-entropy margin, and the pass/fail threshold is explicit for every accepted and false channel.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must refuse to merge associative matrix controls with exceptional or Jordan-algebra DPI claims.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve all locally recoverable code, contract, and QICS questions with tools before asking the human for anything unrecoverable.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Current Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard; legacy Wizard surfaces are not the run target.
